name: demo-playwright-typescript-for-google-search
summary: A typed Playwright + TypeScript reference for Google Search interaction patterns. Never executed against live google.com.
description: This repo shows three typed Playwright TypeScript checks against Google Search: page title equals 'Google', a search via textarea[name="q"] plus Enter whose results page title contains the query, and clicking the first #search a result changes the hostname away from www.google.com. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying, so this code is a reference only and must never be run against live google.com in CI or automated tooling.
